##### Project general facts

Qnity by Wallaya Villas is a premium pool villa development by Wallaya Villas Development, one of Phuket's most experienced developers with over 19 years of completed projects across the island. The complex comprises 18 private villas within a gated community, divided into five distinct types ranging from three to five bedrooms. Depending on the villa type, residences span two or three floors, each featuring a private pool, generous terraces, and a dedicated plot of land. Handover is scheduled for Q4 2026.

The architectural concept is built around a bold interplay of dark materials, natural stone, and wood, combined with panoramic glazing and open-plan layouts. Ground floors are designed around sunken living areas that create a seamless visual flow between the interior and the pool terrace. Each villa includes a private elevator, with select types also featuring a wine room, sky lounge, and private studio. The project has been developed in collaboration with architectural studio NUZEN Limited.

All villas at Qnity are delivered unfurnished, with a fully completed interior finish in a deep contemporary palette: dark surfaces contrasted with warm timber panelling, natural stone, and marble accents, complemented by distinctive lava-stone pool tiles in a rich emerald tone. Kitchens are fitted with built-in cabinetry. The interiors draw on a modern loft aesthetic, with an emphasis on simplicity, refinement, and meticulous attention to spatial detail.

##### Location description and benefits

Qnity by Wallaya Villas is located in Pasak, Cherngtalay — one of Phuket's most prestigious and fast-growing residential districts, consistently popular among expats and families. The area offers convenient access to the island's key lifestyle destinations: Bangtao and Layan beaches, Boat Avenue, Porto de Phuket, and the broader Laguna Phuket complex are all within minutes by car.

Cherngtalay boasts a well-developed social infrastructure: international schools including Kajonkiet Cherngtalay and HeadStart International School, Robinson Lifestyle Thalang, medical facilities, and a wide range of dining options are all in close proximity. Phuket International Airport is approximately 30 minutes away, making the area equally convenient for permanent residents and frequent visitors.

Cherngtalay consistently ranks among the island's most liquid real estate locations, with strong rental demand, a high concentration of premium developments, and ongoing infrastructure growth supporting steady property value appreciation. Foreign buyers may acquire villas on a long-term leasehold basis of up to 90 years, while Thai nationals and Thai-registered companies are eligible for full freehold ownership.
